companies.name: Zupee
companies.what_they_did: Built a mobile gaming platform featuring traditional Indian games like Ludo, Snakes and Ladders, and Carrom. Discontinued gaming operations and laid off its entire workforce while attempting an AI pivot.
companies.story: Founded in 2018, Zupee grew by offering mobile versions of traditional Indian games and raised over $120 million from investors. After multiple rounds of layoffs, the startup announced an AI pivot in October 2026, which sources claimed was a smokescreen for its impending shutdown. By November 2026, the company had laid off its entire workforce and wound down its operations.
reasons: Discontinued its core gaming operations and shut down ventures like NeoAstro and Zupee Studio.
Laid off its entire workforce and failed to launch its announced AI pivot.
Proposed acquisition of microdrama startup Vertical TV fell through.
companies.one_line: Discontinued gaming operations and laid off its entire workforce amid an impending shutdown.
